The '''DX annihilator network''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] criminal organization that operated on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in the years of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[DX-TX]] served as the primary hub of this group who later joined forces with [[Godoba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and the [[Nar Shaddaa Labor Alliance]] to form the [[Shadow Syndicate/Legends|Shadow Syndicate]]. This faction was being courted by the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] into forming an alliance with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="WOU" />

However, [[Ukabi]] of the local [[Exchange]] opposed any alliance with the Syndicate or the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] thus instigating hostilities against the factions on Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="WOU" />
